title: Public ReplayProtector mutation APIs can roll back live Link replay floors
description: LinkLayer exposes a public replay_protector whose reset(), import_state(), and rotate() methods remain callable after activation. import_state can replace a newer live high-water floor with an older exported state; reset/rotate delete peer state outside the Link rekey transaction. A later Link save can sign that semantic rollback at a higher persistence revision. Make replay state mutation Link-owned and lifecycle sealed: one restore before activation, monotonic/non-lowering merge only, and rotation/admin recovery only through an atomic trust transition. Expose at most a read-only facade. Add tests for import/reset/rotate after receive and active SCHC pin, and prove persistence cannot bless lowered floors.
notes: Implementation integration failure: after claiming replay ownership, LinkLayer.receive still called the public check_and_update API and raised 'live replay state is owned by LinkLayer' on every valid frame. All Link-internal replay calls must use the owner capability/internal path; add a valid signed receive regression.
